_about: Sample local partners for the demo (decision 041). These organizations are made up, like the schools: GreatSchools told us real nonprofits and local partners visit schools and know them well, but parents rarely know they exist. A real launch would load GreatSchools' own partner list here. No request reaches anyone.

partners.name: Tidewater Family Navigators
partners.what: A volunteer guide visits schools with you, helps you ask the right questions, and explains how to apply.

partners.name: Sawgrass Parent Partners
partners.what: Parents whose children go to local schools take you on a tour and share what daily life there is like.

partners.name: Mangrove Education Circle
partners.what: A counselor talks through your list with you, then sets up school visits and helps with scholarship forms.

partners.name: Harborlight Parent Guides
partners.what: Guides at the public library help you compare schools and arrange visits, with evening and Saturday times.
